scope: Original retained benchmark outputs; offline aggregation only.
interpretation: owned_cells is territory cell count recorded once per drone per tick. Means are equal-time averages over ticks 1..8000; run means are then equally weighted. Dynamic-minus-static intervals use 15 seed-block means after averaging the matched fixed factor matrix within each seed.
equal_grid_area_check: For every retained mixed run and every tick, four owned_cells counts sum exactly to grid^2.
all_yolo_territory_limit: The matched all-YOLO run index has no drones.csv among 3,240 indexed run directories (summary detail mode). Territory changes by drone therefore cannot be measured or compared from retained all-YOLO outputs.
causal_limit: Dynamic-versus-static is a paired association across the fixed benchmark matrix; it does not isolate perception errors or prove that changing territory caused a mission outcome.

field_definitions.mean_max_min_imbalance: Range of per-drone time-mean owned-cell counts; not the mean instantaneous imbalance. Not used in thesis conclusions.
